{"title":"Best-practices guide for supporting a friend through job loss + job search","content":"## Plan overview
We will gather high-quality, actionable guidance for four focus areas (accountability partnerships, interview prep, confidence/mental health during the search, and balancing emotional support with practical career help). Each area is researched in parallel via a dedicated sub-agent to reduce uncertainty and capture concrete tactics, scripts, do/don’ts, and pitfalls.

## Output deliverable
A synthesized, friend-facing playbook that includes:
- A lightweight accountability structure (cadence, tracking, boundaries)
- A repeatable interview-prep workflow (mock interviews, STAR stories, feedback rubric)
- Confidence/energy maintenance tactics (rejection hygiene, routine, meaning-making, when to encourage professional help)
- A “support vs. fix” framework (what to say, what to avoid, consent-based advising)
- Quick templates: check-in texts, agenda for job-search sessions, post-interview debrief questions

## Method
- Prefer expert/credible references (career services, coaching orgs, mental health resources)
- Convert guidance into concrete, repeatable actions suitable for a friend (not a therapist/coach)
